Slide Masters
PowerPoint presentations can have multiple masters 
The placement and formatting of text objects can be changed on individual slides without affecting the master 
To modify background objects and background animation, you must edit the master, which affects all slides in a presentation.
Slide Masters (cont’d)
Masters determine placement and formatting of text objects, background objects, and background animation effects for every slide in a presentation.
I’m a slide with a Title layout
And I follow the design pattern from the TitleMaster
Click to edit Master title style
